title: Unequal affine module sections are detected at an associated stalk
statement: Let L be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], N a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and V an affine open such that N(V) is finite over O_L(V). For unequal sections s,t in N(V), there exists y in V such that the maximal ideal of O_{L,y} is associated to N_y, and the germs of s and t at y are unequal. Here associated means Mathlib IsAssociatedPrime; on a Noetherian ring this is equivalently the annihilator of an element.

source.place: Tag 0B3M, cyclic image subsheaf argument; Tag 05AR; affine reformulation using Tags 01IA, 01IB, 01HV, 0310

proof.text: Restrict to V and identify the quasi-coherent module with the tilde sheaf of its affine sections. The affine spectrum and stalk dictionaries identify points with primes and germs with localized elements. The section module is over a Noetherian ring.

Apply injectivity into the product of localizations at associated primes to the unequal sections. At least one associated prime p has unequal localized sections; otherwise injectivity would force s=t.

Over a Noetherian ring, isAssociatedPrime_iff replaces the radical-annihilator formulation by an actual annihilator witness. Localize that witness at p. Its annihilator becomes pR_p, the maximal ideal, so the corresponding stalk is associated. Transport via the affine stalk dictionary; the unequal localized sections give unequal germs. This is the cyclic-image proof of 0B3M, with associated and weakly associated primes identified as in 05AR.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_associated_stalk_germ_ne_of_isAffineOpen
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (N : L.Modules)
    (hqc : N.IsQuasicoherent) (V : L.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hfinite : Module.Finite (L.presheaf.obj (op V)) (N.val.obj (op V)))
    (s t : N.val.obj (op V)) (hne : s ≠ t) :
    ∃ (y : L) (hy : y ∈ V),
      IsAssociatedPrime (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (L.presheaf.stalk y))
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y) ∧
      N.presheaf.germ V y hy s ≠ N.presheaf.germ V y hy t
